Lemma
[The comparison function solves the heat equation]

↗ lem:comparison-kernel-solves-heat

\group Heat Equation

If $u$ solves the heat equation below time $\tau $ and $\mu \in \R $, then $v=u-\mu K$ also solves it.
Proof

\sketch Apply linearity of $\partial _t-\Delta $.

□
